title: मोटेल अमेरिका उपन्यासमा आप्रवासी चेतना {Immigrant consciousness in the novel Motel America}
nepali: मोटेल अमेरिका राजवद्वारा रचिएको आप्रवासी चेतना भएको उपन्यास हो । प्रस्तुत उपन्यासमा आप्रवासी अर्थात् डायस्पोराका के कस्ता प्रवृत्तिहरू रहेका छन् भन्ने मूल प्राज्ञिक समस्यामा केन्द्रित रही त्यसका मुख्य प्रवृत्तिहरूको निरूपण गर्ने काम यस लेखमा गरिएको छ । विदेशी भूमिमा बसेर नेपालको थातथलो, नेपाली संस्कृति, भाषा, जीवनपद्धति आदिको नोस्टाल्जियामा रचेका उपन्यासमा आप्रवासी चेतना हुने र यस्ता साहित्यमा जन्मभूमि र इच्छित भूमि, विभाजित मानसिकता, अल्पसङ्ख्यक तथा सीमान्तीकृत हुनुको पीडा, परदेशीय हुनुको रोमाञ्च र चिन्ता, अस्तित्वबोधका लागि एक सूत्रताको खोजी, अतीत मोह, ऐकान्तिकताको चिन्तन तथा संस्कृति भञ्जनको पीडा जस्ता विशेषता आप्रवासी वा डायस्पोरिक साहित्यमा पाइन्छन् । प्रस्तुत उपन्यासमा अमेरिकामा रहेका नेपालीहरूले भोग्नुपरेका दुःख, पीडा, अन्योल, एक्लोपनर अनिश्चितताको अभिव्यक्ति भएको छ । अमेरिकी भूमिमा भोगेका सङ्घर्ष र पीडाका अनुभूतिहरू र परिवार, इष्टमित्र, छिमेकी, साथी–सङ्गीसँग आत्मीय सम्बन्धहरूको विशाल तरङ्ग नै यस उपन्यासको विषयवस्तु बनेर आएको कुराको विश्लेषण गरिएको छ । तसर्थ यस लेखमा मोटेल अमेरिका उपन्यासलाई यिनै विविध आधारमा विश्लेषण गरी आप्रवासी चेतनाकादृष्टिले सफल रहेको उपन्यासका रूपमा निष्कर्ष दिइएको छ ।
american_english: Motel America is a novel bearing immigrant consciousness authored by Rajav. Centering on the core academic problem of what tendencies of immigrants—that is, diaspora—are present in the featured novel, this article undertakes the task of delineating its primary tendencies. Immigrant consciousness resides in novels composed while living on foreign soil out of nostalgia for the ancestral homeland of Nepal, Nepali culture, language, and way of life, and in such literature, characteristics such as the homeland and the desired land, a divided mentality, the pain of being a minority and marginalized, the excitement and anxiety of being abroad, the search for a unifying thread for existential awareness, longing for the past, contemplation of solitude, and the suffering of cultural rupture are identified in immigrant or diasporic literature. In the featured novel, an expression is given to the sorrow, pain, confusion, loneliness, and uncertainty that Nepalese people residing in America have had to endure. An analysis is conducted showing that the subject matter of this novel comprises the experiences of struggle and pain suffered on American soil along with the vast wave of intimate relationships with family, relatives, neighbors, and friends. Therefore, by analyzing the novel Motel America on these varied grounds, this article presents the conclusion that it is a successful novel from the standpoint of immigrant consciousness.

translator_notes: Six sentences translated in strict sequential order. Sentence 3 is a long composite compound-complex sentence in the original Nepali and is strictly preserved as a single sentence across all four variants. Source typos ('एक्लोपनर' for एक्लोपन र, 'आप्रवासी चेतनाकादृष्टिले' run together) noted. Informal translation rendered in Scottish English flavour.
